//: Ubiquitous language map used by HA6 (Single Concern). Each bounded context lists the nouns its public methods are expected to use. A method name is matched to a concern if, once its leading verb (get, set, find, create...) is removed, it STARTS WITH one of the keywords (case-insensitive); the longest matching keyword wins. Names matching no keyword (Id, Name, generic CRUD) belong to no concern. Extend this file as new bounded contexts are carved out - do not add cross-cutting keywords here, that defeats the point.
